exclusions: Native WebIDL brands and DOMException names, unsupported ArrayBuffer sync inputs, platform filename universes, mode/permission flags, negative truncation runtime differences, repeated-close scheduling, invalid-fd exception benchmark, Bun internal Stats fields.
Deno createNew has no atomic exclusive-create facade mapping and is not claimed.
Bun string-yielding async iterators are outside the byte-only iterator input contract.
Copied WPT getWriter control retains writer ownership cleanup; original tests did not release its lock.
WebKit ephemeral acquisition UnknownError is a reported profile limitation; unexpected errors fail instead of skipping.
